name: Extract Function Refactoring
description: Pattern for extracting a code block into a separate reusable function

steps.name: Identify code block
steps.action: Locate and analyze the code block to extract at {{source_file}}:{{line_range}}, identify inputs and outputs
steps.input_template: Source file {{source_file}} exists with code block at lines {{line_range}}
steps.output_template: Code block identified with inputs: {{inputs}} and return value: {{return_type}}

steps.name: Create new function
steps.action: Create function {{function_name}} with identified parameters and return type in {{target_location}}
steps.input_template: Code block analysis complete with inputs and outputs identified
steps.output_template: New function {{function_name}} exists with proper signature and implementation

steps.name: Replace original with call
steps.action: Replace the original code block with a call to {{function_name}}, passing required arguments
steps.input_template: New function is implemented and tested
steps.output_template: Original code block replaced with function call, behavior unchanged

steps.name: Add or update tests
steps.action: Add unit tests for the extracted function verifying its isolated behavior
steps.input_template: Function extraction complete, original behavior preserved
steps.output_template: Test file contains tests for {{function_name}} covering main cases
